title: Definitions — The Coming-Move Share in a Utility Pass-Through Service Final-Statement Projection
content:
**Coming-move share.** For a prepayment of the estimated final Utility Pass-Through Service statement, where the Home-Site Lease the account serves carries a notice to vacate whose vacate date is no more than 14 days after the handling date, the projected daily use is multiplied by 80 percent, and where that vacate date is more than 14 days after the handling date, it is multiplied by 90 percent; a lease carrying no notice to vacate takes no projection share for a coming move.

## Definitions

- **Lease carrying a notice to vacate**: the Home-Site Lease shows the status notice to vacate, with the vacate date stated in that notice.
- **Days to the vacate date**: the vacate date less the handling date, in days. "No more than 14" is 14 or fewer; "more than 14" is 15 or more.
- **Projected daily use**: the daily water use from which the final-cycle consumption is projected; the share multiplies it before the projected consumption is priced.

## Applying the definitions (handling date 10 June, hypothetical)

| Home-Site Lease | Vacate date | Days | Projected daily use multiplied by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Notice to vacate | 20 June | 10 | 80 percent |
| Notice to vacate | 24 June | 14 | 80 percent |
| Notice to vacate | 25 June | 15 | 90 percent |
| Active, no notice to vacate | — | — | no share |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Projected daily use 0.15 kgal with a vacate date 10 days away: 0.15 times 80 percent is 0.12 kgal a day.
